items.title: Chico Hamilton interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 30, 2000
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] The Andy Kaufman of jazz, huh?

ctx.x: To get a reaction. He was just psycho. He knew what you were going to do, how you were going to react.
The Andy Kaufman of jazz, huh? Just to get a rise out of people. If I was to pick out —
